open_graph.og:title: DOM (Document Object Model) - Glossary | MDN
open_graph.og:description: The DOM (Document Object Model) is an API that represents and interacts with any HTML or XML-based markup language document. The DOM is a document model loaded in the browser and representing the document as a node tree, or DOM tree, where each node represents part of the document (e.g., an element, text string, or comment).
